question_en: Which pieces can deliver a skewer?

options.text_cn: 只有马，因为跳法难以预判
options.text_en: Only knights, because their jumps are hard to predict

options.text_cn: 象、车、后——只有能沿直线或斜线"穿透"攻击的棋子
options.text_en: Bishops, rooks, and queens — pieces that can attack through a line
Only queens, because they have the greatest range

explanation_cn: 串击需要"穿线"攻击：象走斜线，车走横竖，后兼而有之。马跳L形、兵只能斜吃一格，无法形成串击。王虽然能走一格，但通常不会主动串击。
explanation_en: A skewer requires a line attack: bishops move diagonally, rooks along ranks and files, and queens do both. Knights jump and pawns capture only one square diagonally, so they cannot skewer. Kings can move along lines but do not normally deliver skewers.
